维护者 2026-11-20 原话：「还有行号好像也不是很有必要，默认是不是可以不开，甚至去掉这个选项」；「不显示行号，checkbox 应该始终显示。」

- 列表首格只放勾选框，始终可见，不再是平时行号、悬停才换成勾选框。
- 「选项」里的「行号」开关去掉，默认值改为关。
- 进行中的 objectstack-ai/objectstack#35646（选项菜单）如果还带着「行号」这一项，请在本卡或那边去掉，两边不要各留一份。

The 行号 switch removal lands after #35646 merges (one copy only, coordinator 7023657319); `ListView.tsx` edits stay off #35643's regions; overlap-check before each push decides the order.

File surface (adds): `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewListRenderer.tsx` (the `defaultRowNumbers={!inSetup}` host line ~1094 only; ux-3's PR #35646 hunks there are elsewhere), `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ListPersonalizedMarker.tsx` (the row-number entry ~40, ~71), and their tests.
Premise corrected (card thread reading at `origin/main`): the console host, not ListView's default, turns row numbers on (`objectViewListRenderer.tsx` ~1094). There is no stored personal row-number setting: `ListView.tsx` ~3019-3023 keeps it as session-only state ("nothing stores it"), so 「之前打开过行号的用户，刷新后也不显示」 holds once the default is off, with nothing to migrate. `ObjectGrid`'s `hostShowRowNumbers ?? true` (~3041) flips to false; `data-table` keeps `showRowNumbers` as an opt-in, and the PR names every host that still opts in.
